text.en:
All orders, issuances, rules and regulations or parts thereof, which
are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby revoked or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately after the end of
the effectivity of the first RFINL on 24 October 1996.

DONE in the City of Manila, this 20th day of August in the year of our Lord,
Nineteen Hundred and Ninety Six.
